title: A link to an imported item whose document names no page
note: Revisions two to seven of 0.4 are not snapshotted; the label bake (data-blyg-label, #81), links[] (#79), CommonMark blockquote extent (#76) and LF/CRLF line endings (#76) come from them, so those cases cite the living text.

items.content_md: A fragment whose document names no page.
items.content_html: A fragment whose document names no page.

ambiguous: §10.1 says the anchor's href is the absolute URL of the target's page (§5.8), and §5.8 lets readers fall back to the reference convention when `page` is absent. Decision #85 says a mention sender in the same position names the item document instead. The expectation accepts either the convention page or the item document.
